verdict.rationale: Featurebase exposes an HTTP API/SDK and webhooks (featurebase-docs-1, featurebase-docs-2) that could theoretically be scripted into a CI/automation pipeline, but there is no documented CLI, headless mode, or CI integration guide, and the OpenAPI spec itself 404s on all probed paths (featurebase-probe-2). missing for 10: explicit CI/headless usage docs, a CLI or automation-focused SDK example, a working machine-readable API schema.
